name: Tabs
blurb: Switch between panels of related content.
mechanism: Radio inputs and labels. `:checked` decides which tab is active and where the indicator sits, so the tab state is form state and the strip needs no script at all. Only the panel's contents are fetched; the links behind them are real pages, so with nothing loaded they are ordinary navigation.
caveats: These are links with tab roles, not an ARIA tablist widget: there is no arrow-key roving focus, and each tab is a separate document to the browser.
If you need the widget semantics, drop the roles and call them what they are - navigation.
